project_type: Compile-to-vanilla frontend framework (ADX). Milestone 1 is a TypeScript/Node compiler distributed as an npm package that turns one .adx component directory into complete static HTML + plain CSS + a tiny hydration-only ES-module glue script. No framework runtime, no vDOM.
build_system: npm + tsc. The compiler package lives in compiler/ with its own package.json ("type":"module"). Build = `tsc -p tsconfig.json` -> dist/. Nothing exists under compiler/ yet; FEAT-001 scaffolds it.
test_framework: Vitest (vitest run). Tests live in compiler/test/*.test.ts.
test_command: cd compiler && npm test   (alias for `vitest run`); lint via `npm run lint` (ESLint flat config).
verification_instructions: After each feature: from compiler/, run `npm install` (first time), `npm run build`, `npm test`, and `npm run lint`. For CLI/SEO checks, build then run `node dist/cli.js build fixtures/user-card --out dist` and `node dist/cli.js check fixtures/user-card`, and confirm dist/user-card/index.html contains no `{{` (grep). Every feature must leave the compiler building, tests green, and lint clean.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The compiler emits dist/<component>/index.html|style.css|glue.js when `adx build` runs. dist/ is gitignored (not checked in). No other generated-and-committed files.
environment_constraints: All file work is inside the worktree /Users/pirrima001/coding/personal/project_adx_0/.worktrees/adx-compiler-m1 — relative paths run from compiler/ resolve there; never write to the parent workspace /Users/pirrima001/coding/personal/project_adx_0. Use `git -C <worktree>` for git. Commit locally on branch adx-compiler-m1; never push. tokens/design-tokens.json lives at the WORKTREE ROOT, not under compiler/.
contribution_requirements: Steering rules apply: (1) token efficiency + AI-workability are the north star; (2) SEO-crawlability is first-class — compiler MUST emit complete static HTML with {{interpolations}} resolved at build time, glue only hydrates existing DOM; (3) keep docs in sync in the same change (agent-reference.md compact, human-guide.md/README warm); (4) error messages MUST match `[ADX] <file>:<line> - <message>` exactly (manifest errors omit the line).
key_patterns: Hand-written tokenizer + recursive-descent parser for structure.adx (no parser-generator). Build-time expression evaluation is a SAFE property walker over ident/member only (no eval, no JS operators). behavior.adx.js is scanned for exports BY NAME, not deep-parsed. HTML scoping = deterministic data-adx-c="<scopeId>" attribute + CSS selectors prefixed with [data-adx-c="<id>"]. Grammar is pinned in docs/adx-grammar.md (already written) — it is the parser's contract; AST shape is in its section 8.
